assets.name: chibi-avatar
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Draw a clearly TWO-DIMENSIONAL CARTOON / ANIME CHIBI version of Bao. The attached adult portrait is ONLY an identity and clothing-color reference; DO NOT use its 3D rendering style. This must look like a hand-drawn anime sticker designed by a character illustrator.
STYLE IS CRITICAL: bold clean dark outline around silhouette, thinner internal expressive ink lines, simple flat color fills, just ONE crisp cel-shadow color per surface, minimal highlights. Graphic simplified cartoon design, not a tiny realistic child. NO skin pores, NO realistic face shading, NO CG, NO 3D, NO photographic lighting, NO soft airbrushed gradients, NO fabric weave, NO individual realistic hair strands. No baby-doll look. Think lively expressive manga mascot with rounded playful shapes.
RECOGNIZABLE IDENTIFIERS: soft rounded fuller cheeks, warm medium peach complexion, thick expressive eyebrows, large friendly simplified dark-brown anime eyes, tiny shorthand cartoon nose, small warm smile. Thin silver geometric double-bridge glasses drawn in clean ink, clear open lenses. Black tousled WAVY hair with his characteristic side part and loose forehead locks, reinterpreted as 8-12 broad graphic wavy black tufts with simple dark blue shadow blocks and a couple of narrow graphic highlights, not realistic hair.
PROPORTIONS: adorable compact chibi, approximately 2.3 heads tall for full-body poses, very large rounded head and small expressive body, small simplified mitten-like hands and small shoes. Character feels like a cartoon of the adult, not a photorealistic child.
OUTFIT: NAVY three-piece suit with visible vest, pale-blue collar and BLUE tie, navy overcoat with simplified broad lapels, dark tiny shoes. Minimal elegant line details and flat shades. When visible, a tiny silver bracelet watch with blue dial on the OUTSIDE of LEFT wrist (clasp on palm side). No camel/burgundy clothing.
Single figure, square canvas, complete silhouette with breathing room, genuinely TRANSPARENT background, no opaque backdrop, text, lettering, watermark, panel, white sticker border or badge.
ASSET: chibi-avatar. HEAD AND SHOULDERS ONLY, facing viewer with a friendly closed-mouth smile and slight playful head tilt. Show full black wavy hair silhouette, glasses, navy coat lapels and pale-blue shirt/BLUE tie. No hands, no watch, no props. Hair and face fill roughly 65 percent of frame. Flat 2D anime-cartoon art, bold outlines and simple cel shading.

Keep the wrist position, hand pose and cuff exactly as they are.

waveWatchCorrection:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit the attached portrait. Correct ONLY the wristwatch placement on the raised LEFT wrist at the viewer's right.
The man is waving with his PALM facing the camera. The current blue watch dial incorrectly sits on the INSIDE/palmar surface of the wrist. It must look like a real normally worn integrated-bracelet watch, no loose oversized bangle.
Preserve absolutely everything else: same actual face, full cheeks, identity, hair, silver glasses, smile, skin, navy three-piece suit with vest, pale-blue shirt, navy tie, navy wool overcoat, brown notebook, pose with raised palm and five fingers, cinematic lighting, warm ivory background, composition and square dimensions.
